answer: For an agent market that pays robots to inspect a vine along a copper fence in a meadow, require a fresh proof of work per voting key. After the round seed is announced, peers verify that the hash of the seed, public key and nonce falls below a public target, then credit each key once. A proof cannot be moved to another key. At a target with a one-in-a-million hit rate, 500 voting keys take about 500 million hash trials on average, even when the work runs in parallel.
